choices.reason: No rule separates these reports of the same unadjusted, full-sample paired originality contrast; neither has priority by primary designation, specification, session, arms, or task. Both leave aggregation of each participant's solutions and the SD level unspecified and supply no data_stats, so c246's additional z statistic and r interval do not establish a participant-level standardized effect under rule 3.
